commands.cmd: ruby -ryaml -rjson -rdate -e 'root="skills/thien-skill-risk-process-control"; paths=Dir.glob(root+"/**/*.yaml"); paths.each { |p| YAML.safe_load(File.read(p), permitted_classes: [Date, Time], aliases: false) }; front=File.read(root+"/SKILL.md").split(/^---\s*$/,3)[1]; meta=YAML.safe_load(front, aliases: false); raise "description too long" if meta.fetch("description").length > 200; puts JSON.pretty_generate({status:"pass",yaml_files:paths.length,frontmatter:true,description_characters:meta.fetch("description").length})'

limitations: Tooling/structural/registry checks are not behavioral runs or native installation.
The historical registry output is freshly executed without overwriting historical result files.
